profile.headline: Software Engineer at Envive AI
profile.summary:
Portafolio: https://kristophermt3z.com
I’m a Full-Stack Engineer who likes turning slow, manual processes into automated tools that people can run on their own.
I’ve worked across e-commerce, fintech and government, and I’ve launched my own SaaS. Along the way I’ve built AI-powered data pipelines, LLM-based evaluation systems, self-service dashboards, secure payment systems and digital wallets, and a platform that connects judicial entities across the country.
What I enjoy most is owning a problem end to end. I like to understand what slows a team down, design both the backend and the UI, and ship something non-technical people can use without waiting on an engineer. Some of that work has turned processes that took days into minutes.
Day to day I work with Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, Temporal, LLM and Google Cloud. Earlier in my career I worked with NestJS and Node.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned the client-onboarding domain end to end and onboarded and migrated dozens of brands to the latest platform version. I was part of the team that cut new-client launch time from ~3 months to as little as 2 days through self-service tooling, before I later took full ownership of the domain.

Built a full-stack, AI-assisted data quality evaluation system that scores client catalogs with automated checks and LLM-as-judge, and points to the exact records to fix before launch.

Automated data ingestion with AI, generating and validating each clients data configuration and cutting setup from ~2 days of engineering work to ~5 minutes. Built a dashboard to monitor and trigger data syncs without engineering involvement.

Built a scheduled monitoring service that checks each clients live integration and catches issues early, instead of waiting for something to break.

Consolidated several startup network requests, including A/B test resolution, into a single backend endpoint to reduce page-load time. Moved URL processing from the browser to the backend.

Designed configurable ranking and grouping for search and recommendations, including price- and discount-aware weighting, replacing hardcoded per-client logic.

Turned custom per-client development into no-code, self-service tools for non-technical teams, working directly with them to translate their needs into requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Next.js · React.js · Elasticsearch · Temporal · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Fullstack / Backend JavaScript Engineer
positions.description:
Under NDA (Fintech / Financial Services)
Worked in the financial/fintech sector across two projects for the same client, contributing as both a Fullstack JavaScript Engineer and a Backend Engineer.

Fullstack JavaScript Engineer (Vue 3,  Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS) :
- Maintained and enhanced existing frontend and backend modules in a financial platform.
- Collaborated closely with the data team to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of financial data across the system.
- Extracted, analyzed, and audited complex SQL queries to validate data flows between the frontend and the database.
- Identified and resolved data discrepancies to improve reliability and system trustworthiness.

Backend Engineer (NestJS, TypeORM, PostgreSQL, AWS)
- Developed core backend infrastructure for upcoming fintech platforms, including a digital wallet, admin panel, and user-facing applications.
- Designed and implemented scalable backend services using NestJS and TypeORM.
- Integrated STP (Straight Through Processing) services for secure and efficient payment handling.
- Contributed to building a robust, modular backend architecture aligned with fintech best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · JavaScript · Next.js · Vue.js · TypeScript · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · TypeORM · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Fullstack JavaScript Engineer
positions.description:
Poder Judicial del Estado de Colima
Worked for the government on a national digital transformation project, interconnecting judicial entities through web APIs to improve collaboration and data exchange. Implemented secure user authentication and developed an admin panel to strengthen administrative control. Designed and implemented a statistics module that empowered users to create and execute custom queries, enabling the extraction of meaningful insights from judicial data. Built modules for tracking and managing assigned expedients, including a pop-up viewer for quick access and self-assignment functionality. Additionally, resolved an issue with automatic page refresh, improving system stability and user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Node.js · Express.js · MySQL · Algorithms · Data Structures · TypeORM · AngularJS

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description: Developed a custom inventory system for a real estate company, which included user authentication to ensure secure access, provided comprehensive control over the materials and resources used in production, and enabled the registration of available houses as part of the inventory. Additionally, the system featured a scheduling capability through a calendar. Furthermore, I refactored code and migrated it between versions, making the necessary adjustments to ensure seamless transitions.

honors.title: Participante en Expociencias Nacional Sonora 2020
honors.description:
I participated in this national event representing my Institution "Tecnológico Nacional de México Campus Colima" with a project named "ATE (Activa Tu Economia)".
The project was developed with Social Impact, which created a Digital Marketing agency that used Data Analysis for metrics. The implementation of different tools allowed us to nurture the economy of small and medium enterprises, whose economy had been affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. This project received the pass representing Colima in the National " Expociencias " competition virtually in Sonora.
honors.issuer: Issued by M.C Roberto Hidalgo Rivas · Dec 2020

volunteerExperiences.description:
Grupo Ambiental Ola Verde 
Coordinated many events like "Desempapélate", "Reciclón de electrónicos", "Aqua Fest", etc. I have actively
participated in some of the projects we've created and launched for the public like "Plataforma Net zero".

Hackathon
The project consisted in giving Reutilization to disposable containers by providing collection centers in different locations in Colima so these containers are recollected, and therefore can be used for different sustainable purposes.
